verdict.rationale: The evidence shows observability only inside Portkey's own product: a Logs view, shareable log URLs, manual feedback, and in-platform tracing and metrics. Nothing documents exporting logs or traces to an external observability stack, such as an OpenTelemetry/OTLP exporter, a log export API, or third-party sinks. The axis clearly applies to an LLM gateway, so this absence yields none.
